title: Complete rule, action, and condition pack procedures
description:
Model the deterministic rule / action / condition clauses in the pack, and put
their readiness in-band (with A4).

Pack evidence on main @4384f25: all 335 rule records carry only
{text, tableRefs, skillsByAbility} — no mechanics projection, no disposition, no
readiness. The rule corpus is prose-only.

Required membership — all of:
- rule corpus classification and executable clause data;
- Search's paired alternatives;
- Help's first-qualifying-attack cardinality;
- condition acquisition / effects / recovery / lifecycle where not already typed;
- exhaustion / rest interaction;
- action economy and termination semantics.

Closes findings: F-09, F-16, CAP-001, CAP-002, SOL-003 (rule surface).

IMPORTANT — do not over-correct: Sol CAP-002 OVERSTATED the current condition
deficit. This bead must independently reconcile all condition clauses and
PRESERVE already-correct typed effects rather than replacing them
indiscriminately. The 2026-07-24 independent audit verified conditions as exact
against source.

acceptance_criteria:
- Every rule record is classified, and deterministic rule clauses carry executable clause data plus in-band readiness.
- Search and Help carry their printed cardinality and alternative structure.
- Condition lifecycle (acquisition, effects, recovery, termination) is complete, with existing correct typed effects preserved — verified by a before/after diff that shows no regression in already-typed condition mechanics.
- Exhaustion/rest interaction is executable.
- Prose-only classification is an explicit, reviewed disposition, never a default.
